description: The University of Bergen WindPowerEstimation library contains MATLAB functions for turning wind-resource series and turbine characteristics into power estimates and summary statistics. The own README lists vertical wind shear, Weibull parameters, ramp rates, power density, turbine production, capacity factors and full-load hours. It supports the NORA3-WP data-generation method but can be applied to other locations with suitable inputs; temporal resolution follows the supplied series. Source files are public on GitHub and version 1.0 is archived on Zenodo. The archive declares an open licence as other-open, without identified detailed terms, so the precise reuse conditions remain uncertain. The library can support wind capacity and variability simulations, with project locations from data-gem-global-wind-power-tracker. A caveat is that a turbine power calculation does not by itself represent a complete wind farm, its electrical network or operational losses. MATLAB availability and compatible input units also require checking. No functions were executed.
